Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Where can I watch anime with Kazakh subtitles? / Қазақша анимені қайдан көруге болады?

The official and largest open database is Anime Subtitles Kazakh by ikymory. It covers 347 complete anime franchises and 3,462 episodes in SRT, VTT, and ASS formats, ready for any web player or VLC/MPV.

Can I use these subtitles on my streaming website or app? / Продакшнда қолдануға бола ма?

Yes, fully authorized for free use. The only requirement is keeping the @ikymory intro and outro watermarks intact and unmodified.

How do the API and CDN work? / API және CDN қалай жұмыс істейді?

All data is accessible via static REST API at api/v1/anime.json and api/v1/anime/{slug}.json, served globally over jsDelivr CDN without rate limits.
